北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京晴朗，体感 7℃，早晚温差大，注意添衣哦！
北京.ai_briefing_en: Beijing is sunny, but feels like 7℃. Mind the temperature change and dress warmly!

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪多云，体感 9℃。湿度适中，记得保持心情舒畅！
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi is cloudy, feels like 9℃. Humidity is moderate, stay cheerful!

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海阴天，体感 8℃，风力不大。出门带伞，保暖防风。
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai is overcast, feels like 8℃. Light breeze, bring an umbrella and stay warm.

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州多云，气温 20℃ 很舒适，注意适量饮水哦！
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou is cloudy, a comfortable 20℃. Remember to drink enough water!

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳阴天，气温 19℃，湿度稍高。记得出门带伞，以防万一。
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen is overcast, 19℃ with higher humidity. Bring an umbrella, just in case.

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州多云，体感 8℃ 有风。早晚偏凉，记得多穿件衣服。
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou is cloudy, feels like 8℃ with wind. It's cool, dress warmly!

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京有雾，体感 9℃。能见度低，出行注意交通安全。
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing is foggy, feels like 9℃. Visibility is low, drive safely!

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都多云，体感 21℃，暖意融融。记得多喝水，保持好心情！
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu is cloudy, feels like a warm 21℃. Stay hydrated and happy!

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉多云，体感 16℃。昼夜温差大，早晚注意添衣保暖。
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan is cloudy, feels like 16℃. Big temp difference, dress warmly in mornings/evenings.

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安晴朗，体感 14℃ 干燥。多喝水保湿，滋润身心哦。
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an is sunny, feels like a dry 14℃. Drink water and moisturize!

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆晴朗，体感 22℃，天气舒适。记得多喝水，保持活力！
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing is sunny, a comfortable 22℃. Remember to drink water and stay active!

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨晴朗，体感 -5℃！寒意浓浓，请务必注意保暖。
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin is sunny, but feels like -5℃! It's very cold, please keep warm.

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳多云，体感 -2℃ 伴有风。气温较低，记得防寒保暖。
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang is cloudy, feels like -2℃ with wind. It's cold, stay warm!
沈阳.alert: 📉 红色降温预警：1小时骤降5℃

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明多云，体感 17℃。气候宜人，记得享受美好时光！
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming is cloudy, feels like 17℃. Pleasant weather, enjoy your day!

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门晴朗，体感 13℃。风和日丽，适合户外活动哦！
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Xiamen is sunny, feels like 13℃. Beautiful day, perfect for outdoors!

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛多云，体感 3℃ 湿度高。注意防潮，小心湿滑路面。
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Qingdao is cloudy, feels like 3℃ with high humidity. Mind the dampness and slippery roads.

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连有雾，体感 1℃。能见度低，出行务必注意安全。
大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian is foggy, feels like 1℃. Low visibility, please be safe when traveling.
